name: Ground Beef and Zucchini Pesto Skillet
why: Verified published nutrition: 414 cal / 5.8g total carbs (3.6g net) / 23.8g protein per serving at 6 servings - squarely in the low-carb band. Structurally low-carb (beef + zucchini + pesto + cheese, no rice/pasta/potato/bean base), so drift is upward-safe: swapping the recipe's lean beef for board 80/20 ground beef raises calories off the 400 floor rather than below it. Pure stovetop skillet, weigh-and-divide friendly at 14 servings. Mediterranean profile adds cuisine variety versus the American/Tex-Mex-heavy catalog, and is distinct from the accepted beef-skillets (stroganoff, cheeseburger, steak bites+zucchini, steak fajita, flank+green beans). Carries two genuine board-absent ingredients (goat cheese, sun-dried tomatoes) - a deliberate feature for the pricer-lane proving run.
confidence: high - nutrition read directly from the recipe card, not a snippet
